summary: Risk-off sentiment dominates today, with crypto and tech under pressure while gold and the dollar attract safe-haven flows. The strongest bearish signals are concentrated in BTC, ETH, and related high-beta altcoins, while several traders are still looking for selective rebounds in FX and commodities.
